notes.title: Mr.Wise Long Demo Has Been Released!
notes.content:
[h1]Mr.Wise Long Demo Has Been Released![/h1]

[h3]With it's nearly one hour of gameplay time and two different endings; it showcases a small glimpse of what we're up to with our narrative game stories.[/h3]

[h2]If you like the demo, you may kindly [b]wishlist the game[/b] to show your appreciation.[/h2]

[h3]We're hoping you to enjoy the demo and leave feedbacks so we can further improve both the story and the game itself.[/h3]

[h3]Don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42669497]Steam Page[/url] for our other titles.[/h3]
